messages:
Ana: Quick sync — our biweekly release for core infra currently lands on 2024-12-20 per the calendar. With several APAC & EU folks OOO the following week, should we move the cutoff up ~48h so we get a canary + rollback window before holidays?

CJ: +1 to earlier cutoff. Triage windows shrink when people are OOO. Proposed: cutoff = 2024-12-18 23:59 UTC, branch freeze 12/18 02:00 UTC.

Lina: FYI I'm happy to hand off changelog edits to @Sam if we bump. Sam ok with that?

Sam: I can take changelog + smoke deploy. Ping me in the morning of 12/19 and I'll run through the checklist.

Dmitri: Are we ok bumping the patch version earlier? Need to ensure Dedicated doesn't have queued rollouts that assume the later date. I'll check release-dashboard and queued deployments.

Ana: @release-bot can you post current queued PRs affecting the release train?

release-bot: Automated reminder: Release queue snapshot — 7 PRs queued; 2 labeled "needs-changelog"; 1 failing e2e on canary. See dashboard: https://internal/release-dashboard/queue/1715223344

CJ: If the failing e2e is real we should block. @Dmitri do you want to own a fix or should we drop that PR from this train?

Dmitri: I'll take it and aim for EOD. If I can't get it resolved by 18:00 UTC I'll flag to drop.

Lina: Changelog process reminder — please add a one-line entry under Unreleased and include a component tag. Example:

```
- infra: avoid race in KV cache warmup (dmitri) #4321
```

Ana: Also please make sure to add the subteam label (eng-runtime / eng-ml / eng-platform) so release notes grouping works.

Sam: Noted. I'll take the changelog + quick smoke on the canary after Dmitri's fix lands.

Ana: One more: we need oncall/post-release monitoring coverage 12/20-12/26. If we move cutoff earlier, the post-release window shifts. Who can cover 12/20-12/22 mornings (US) and who can cover 12/22-12/26 EU?

Sam: I can do 12/20-12/22 morning US shift.

Lina: I can cover EU 12/22-12/26.

CJ: I'll add both to the release calendar and create a short handoff doc in the runbook.

Ana: Thanks all. I'll update the release calendar now and formally bump the cutoff if Dmitri confirms the fix or we decide to drop the PR. Will post final cutoff + freeze times in this thread by EOD.

CJ: :party_parrot:
